newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan finance minister may visit China on June 24.
newsitem.headline: Japan finance minister may visit China on June 24.

text.p: Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka may stop off in Beijing on June 24 for a visit after the Group of Seven (G7) industrialised nations' summit meeting in Denver, a ministry spokesman said on Friday.
Mitsuzuka, who will be attending the G7 summit meeting from June 20 to 22, may visit China on June 24 and stay until June 26 or 27, depending on his schedule, the spokesman said.
The ministry is trying to arrange the visit at the request of the finance minister and it is currently coordinating the visit with Chinese authorities, he said.
Jiji news agency said Mitsuzuka is expected to explain what was discussed at the G7 Denver summit during his visit to China.
